description.en: Smart photography assistant built with Flutter that combines real-time AI pose estimation (Google ML Kit) and on-device image processing to guide users into better poses and compositions before pressing the shutter.
description.id: Asisten fotografi cerdas berbasis Flutter yang menggabungkan pose estimation AI real-time (Google ML Kit) dan pemrosesan citra on-device untuk memandu pengguna menemukan pose dan komposisi terbaik sebelum menekan tombol rana.

impact.en: Delivered a cross-platform camera app with ghost overlay pose guidance, cosine-similarity scoring, live color filters, GPU-accelerated photo editor, and a Supabase-backed cloud pose library accessible after login.
impact.id: Menghadirkan aplikasi kamera cross-platform dengan panduan pose ghost overlay, skoring cosine similarity, filter warna live, editor foto berakselerasi GPU, dan cloud pose library berbasis Supabase yang dapat diakses setelah login.

highlights.en: Real-time ghost overlay skeleton drawn via CustomPainter that color-shifts red → yellow → green as cosine-similarity score surpasses 82%.
highlights.id: Ghost overlay skeleton real-time via CustomPainter yang berubah warna merah → kuning → hijau saat skor cosine similarity melampaui 82%.

highlights.en: ML pipeline runs Google ML Kit Pose Detection on camera frames in a background isolate, extracting 33 body landmarks per frame with throttling to preserve UI frame rate.
highlights.id: Pipeline ML menjalankan Google ML Kit Pose Detection di isolate background, mengekstrak 33 landmark tubuh per frame dengan throttling agar frame rate UI tetap stabil.

highlights.en: GPU-accelerated photo editor: adjustments (brightness, contrast, saturation, color temperature) are composed into a single 5×4 color matrix and rendered via Flutter Canvas/PictureRecorder for zero-lag saves.
highlights.id: Editor foto berakselerasi GPU: penyesuaian (kecerahan, kontras, saturasi, suhu warna) digabungkan menjadi satu matriks 5×4 dan dirender via Flutter Canvas/PictureRecorder untuk penyimpanan tanpa lag.

highlights.en: Dual storage strategy: Hive (local, offline-first) for custom pose templates and Supabase (PostgreSQL + Storage Bucket) for the cloud public pose library with download-count tracking.
highlights.id: Strategi penyimpanan ganda: Hive (lokal, offline-first) untuk template pose kustom dan Supabase (PostgreSQL + Storage Bucket) untuk cloud public pose library dengan tracking download count.

highlights.en: Clean Architecture layers (Domain / Data / Presentation) with ChangeNotifier controllers, keeping all camera lifecycle, flash, zoom, and capture state out of the UI layer.
highlights.id: Lapisan Clean Architecture (Domain / Data / Presentation) dengan controller ChangeNotifier, memisahkan semua state lifecycle kamera, flash, zoom, dan capture dari lapisan UI.

highlights.en: Pose Template Builder: extract pose landmarks from any gallery photo, persist them locally, and browse or share them via the cloud library.
highlights.id: Pose Template Builder: ekstrak landmark pose dari foto galeri mana pun, simpan lokal, dan telusuri atau bagikan via cloud library.
